title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Time Tracking
architecture_notes: Workday Time Tracking captures hours for non-exempt (hourly) employees, student workers, and any position requiring time entry. Time blocks are coded with worktags for labor distribution. Approval workflows route to the supervisory org manager. Unlike PeopleSoft Time & Labor (which uses Time Reporter Data and Reported Time), Workday time entry is tightly integrated with the worker's primary position and compensation.

source_objects.description: A reported time entry: worker, date, hours, time entry code (regular, overtime, holiday, sick), worktag coding. Equivalent to PS_TL_RPTD_TIME.
Classification of time: Regular, Overtime, Double Time, Holiday, Comp Time. Equivalent to PS_TRC_TBL.
Clock-in/clock-out events (if web clock or time clock integration enabled). Equivalent to PS_TL_PUNCH_DATA.
Aggregated time blocks for a pay period, with approval status.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Reported hours for this entry.
Cast to ISO 8601 datetime. Null if no clock events.
Map to HELIX org code. Where the labor cost is charged.
If time is charged to a grant (common for student research assistants).
Resolve to name. Typically the supervisory org manager.
